parse_propositions_from_llm: parse raw LLM output strings wrapped in [FN] tags into a list of EvaluationProposition objects
parse_temporal_constraint_from_llm: parse LLM output into a TemporalConstraint DAG grouping propositions into ordered satisfaction groups
parse_tie_constraints_from_llm: parse LLM output into SameArgConstraint or DifferentArgConstraint objects linking proposition argument values
generate_scene_state_string: generate a textual scene representation from metadata including objects, furniture, rooms, and their relations
split_instruction_into_temporal_subinstr: split a natural language instruction into temporal sub-instructions using temporal word delimiters like then and after
